{"diagnosis":"Batch 13 delivered txn_ts as epoch milliseconds (e.g. '1768629721000') instead of 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS', so the TIMESTAMP cast fails. Read as UTC, 1768629721000 is 2026-01-17 06:02:01. That matches the pattern of other batches, where each batch holds the previous day's data starting around 06:00 and is ingested at 02:00 the next day. The fix parses 13-digit values as epoch ms and casts the rest as before.","decision":"fix","confidence":0.88,"pre_sql":[],"step_overrides":{"silver_transactions":"CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS
WITH parsed AS (
  SELECT *,
         CASE WHEN regexp_matches(txn_ts, '^[0-9]{13}$') THEN epoch_ms(CAST(txn_ts AS BIGINT))
              ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS ts_parsed
  FROM raw_transactions
)
SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id,
       customer_id,
       CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id,
       CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount,
       ts_parsed AS txn_ts,
       CAST(ts_parsed AS DATE) AS txn_date
FROM parsed
WHERE status = 'POSTED';"}}
